Users will typically SSH to Anvil ( <username>@anvil.rcac.purdue.edu ) but note this lands you on a login node .
The charge unit for Anvil is the Service Unit (SU) .
This corresponds to the equivalent use of one compute core utilizing less than approximately 2G of data in memory for one hour.
You can choose which queues you want access to by exchanging your Service Units (credits) for the corresponding queue (CPU, GPU, AI).

Jobs submitted to the large memory nodes ( highmem partition) will be charged 4 SU per compute core (4x wholenode node charge).
Filesystem storage is not charged.
